title: Finding Parameter for Global Continuity
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the value of constant k that makes f(x) = k*x^2 for x <= 2 and f(x) = 2x + k for x > 2 continuous everywhere.

steps.title: Evaluate Left-Hand Limit and Function Value at x = 2
steps.explanation: Substitute x = 2 into the left branch k*x^2.
steps.why: Polynomials are continuous on their domain.

steps.title: Evaluate Right-Hand Limit at x = 2
steps.explanation: Substitute x = 2 into the right branch 2x + k.
steps.why: Linear functions are continuous on their domain.

steps.title: Equate Left and Right Limits for Continuity
steps.explanation: Set left-hand limit equal to right-hand limit and solve for k.
steps.why: Continuity at x = 2 requires left and right limits to be equal to f(2).
